rebuttal_or_critique: Given the headline CPI at 7.01% and the persistent core inflation at 6.20%, the urgency of anchoring inflation expectations has increased. The positive output gap of 0.40% and the substantial systemic liquidity surplus of 190,000 crore INR indicate that the economy possesses the resilience to absorb a 50 bps adjustment. While my preference for a calibrated approach to preserve growth remains, the current macroeconomic reality requires a front-loaded move to align real rates toward neutral and mitigate exchange rate pressures. I am satisfied that this consensus does not sacrifice long-term growth and serves to protect the economy from the risks of unanchored inflation expectations.
